verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents after-response scripting, automated tests across collections, test import from Postman, and running API tests through the Inso CLI, so a test-assertion capability clearly exists. However, no evidence shows assertions specifically against response status, body, or headers. missing for 10: documented assertion syntax/API for status codes, body content, and headers; examples of after-response test assertions; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write test assertions against response status, body, and headers

citations.quote: Pre-request and after-response scripting to add logic to your requests
Automatically test multiple requests in your collections, with unlimited collection runs.
Use the Insomnia CLI to automate the execution of your API tests using your existing Git workflows.
